text.en:
On hit against Rank-And-File Combatants:
Grants 1 Stack of Redirection, up to a maximum of 20 Stacks.

On hit against Elite, Miniboss, or Boss Combatants:
Grants 20% increased damage per stack, up to 100% at 5 Stacks.

Consumes 1 stack per hit if at or below 5 stacks.
Consumes 5 stacks per hit if at or above 6 stacks.

Check out <link this sheet [https://d2clarity.page.link/combatant] /> for Combatant Classifications.

enhanced (
#e Grants 25(?)% increased damage per stack, up to 125(?)% at 5 Stacks.
)
text.zh-chs:
命中普通敌人时：
获得 1 层转向增益，最高叠加 10 层。

命中精英、次级首领、首领敌人时：
每层增益 +20% 伤害，最高 100%。

当增益层数不高于 5 层时，每次命中消耗 1 层增益。
当增益层数高于 5 层时，每次命中消耗 5 层增益。

查询 <link 该表格 [https://d2clarity.page.link/combatant] /> 获取敌人分级信息。

enhanced (
#e 每层增益 +25(?)% 伤害，最高 +125(?)% 伤害。
)

text.en:
On hit against Minor Combatants:
Grants 1 Stack of Redirection, up to a maximum of 20 Stacks.

On hit against Major or Boss Combatants:
Grants 20% increased damage for 1 shot per stack, up to 100% at 5 Stacks.

Consumes 1 stack per hit if at 1-5 stacks.
Consumes #e${5-#d} stacks per hit if at 6-20 stacks.

enhanced (
var d = 1
#e Consumes 1 fewer stack per hit if at 6-20 stacks.
)
